data.title: Bitcoin ETFs Face $1B Exodus As Ethereum, Solana Funds Bleed: Is Institutional Crypto Demand Cracking?
data.description: U.S. spot crypto ETFs suffered a broad-based exodus in the five trading days ended Nov. 10, with all six tracked asset groups recording net outflows totaling $1.48 billion, raising fresh questions about investor confidence amid a sharp cryptocurrency market downturn.Bitcoin CRYPTO:BTCUSD ETFs bore…
